```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(argparser)
library(clusterProfiler)
library(reshape2)
library(ggplot2)
library(stringr)
library(tibble)
library(dplyr)
library(DOSE)
library(org.Hs.eg.db)
library(org.Rn.eg.db)
library(org.Mm.eg.db)
library(org.Oar3.eg.db)
library(enrichplot)

argv <- arg_parser('')
argv <- add_argument(argv,"--genetype", help="the gene type",default="ENSEMBL")
argv <- add_argument(argv,"--species", help="the type species. one of the hsa,mmu or rno")
argv <- add_argument(argv,"--plottype", help="one of the GO,KEGG,reactome or DO")
argv <- add_argument(argv,"--By", help="cluster or group for enrichment",default="cluster")
argv <- add_argument(argv,"--outdir", help="the output folder",default="./result")
argv <- parse_args(argv)


genetype <- argv$genetype  #SYMBOL,ENSEMBL
species <- argv$species
plottype <- argv$plottype
By <- argv$By
outdir <- argv$outdir

if (species == "hsa"){
    db = 'org.Hs.eg.db'
    spe = "human"
}else if (species == "mmu"){
    db = 'org.Mm.eg.db'
    spe = "mouse"
}else if (species == "rno"){
    db = 'org.Rn.eg.db'
    spe = "rat"
}else if (species == "oar"){
    db = 'org.Oar3.eg.db'
    spe = "sheep"
}else{
    stop("the value of the 'species' parameter must be one of the hsa,mmu or rno.")
}

geneForGO <- c('CDKN1A','EDN1','HSPA5','HMOX1','HSP90AA1','ITGAV','JAK2','LMNA','MSN','MYH9','SQSTM1','PECAM1','SERPINE1','STAT3','VCL')
eg <- bitr(geneForGO,fromType = 'SYMBOL',toType = 'ENTREZID',OrgDb = "org.Hs.eg.db")
#Kegg enrichment
kegg_enrich <- function(eg,species,outdir,prefix) {
    genenames<-eg$SYMBOL
    names(genenames)<-eg$ENTREZID
    genelist <- eg$ENTREZID
    download.KEGG.Path <- function (species) {
    keggpathid2extid.df <- clusterProfiler:::kegg_link(species, "pathway")
    if (is.null(keggpathid2extid.df)) {
      message <- paste("Failed to download KEGG data.", "Wrong 'species' or the network is unreachable.", 
                     "The 'species' should be one of organisms listed in", 
                     "'https://www.genome.jp/kegg/catalog/org_list.html'")
      stop(message)
    }
    keggpathid2extid.df[, 1] %<>% gsub("[^:]+:", "", .)
    keggpathid2extid.df[, 2] %<>% gsub("[^:]+:", "", .)
    keggpathid2name.df <- clusterProfiler:::kegg_list("pathway")
    keggpathid2name.df[, 1] %<>% gsub("map", species, .)
    keggpathid2extid.df <- keggpathid2extid.df[keggpathid2extid.df[, 1] %in% keggpathid2name.df[, 1], ]
    return(list(KEGGPATHID2EXTID = keggpathid2extid.df, KEGGPATHID2NAME = keggpathid2name.df))
  }

    assignInNamespace('download.KEGG.Path',download.KEGG.Path,ns = 'clusterProfiler')
    head(genelist)
    kegg <- enrichKEGG(genelist, organism = species, keyType = 'kegg', pAdjustMethod = 'BH',pvalueCutoff = 1,qvalueCutoff = 1,use_internal_data = FALSE)
    gene_list <- strsplit(kegg$geneID,split='/')
    geneName<-unlist(lapply(gene_list,FUN=function(x){paste(genenames[x],collapse='/')}))
   
    KEGGenrich <- data.frame(kegg[,1:8],geneName,kegg[,9,drop=F])
    KEGGenrich$cluster <- prefix
    write.table(KEGGenrich,file=paste(outdir,'/',prefix,'_KEGGenrich.xls',sep=''),sep='\t',quote=F,row.names=F)
    pdf(paste0(outdir,'/',prefix,'_KEGG_dot.pdf',sep=''),width = 8, height = 8)
    print(dotplot(kegg, showCategory=20))
    dev.off()
    pdf(paste0(outdir,'/',prefix,'_KEGG_bar.pdf',sep=''),width = 8, height = 8)
    print(barplot(kegg, showCategory=20))
    dev.off()
    png(paste0(outdir,'/',prefix,'_KEGG_dot.png',sep=''),width = 780, height = 580)
    print(dotplot(kegg, showCategory=20))
    dev.off()
    png(paste0(outdir,'/',prefix,'_KEGG_bar.png',sep=''),width = 780, height = 580)
    print(barplot(kegg, showCategory=20))
    dev.off()
}

# reactome enrichment
reactome_enrich <- function(eg,species,outdir,prefix) {
    library(msigdbr)
    library(ReactomePA)
    library(pathview)
    genelist <- eg$ENTREZID
    ereactome <- enrichPathway(gene=genelist,organism = species,pvalueCutoff = 1,readable=TRUE)
    if (dim(ereactome)[1]==0){
      stop('No reactome!')
    }
    res_reactome <- as_tibble(ereactome) %>% mutate(Link=str_c('https://reactome.org/content/detail/',ID)) 
    write.table(res_reactome, file=paste0(outdir,'/',prefix,'_reactome.xls',sep=''),sep='\t',quote=F,row.names=F)
    pdf(paste0(outdir,'/',prefix,'_reactome_bar.pdf',sep=''),width = 15, height = 9)
    print(barplot(ereactome,showCategory=20,drop=T))
    dev.off()
    pdf(paste0(outdir,'/',prefix,'_reactome_dot.pdf',sep=''),width = 15, height = 8)
    print(dotplot(ereactome,showCategory=20))
    dev.off()
    png(paste0(outdir,'/',prefix,'_reactome_bar.png',sep=''),width = 1080, height = 580)
    print(barplot(ereactome,showCategory=20,drop=T))
    dev.off()
    png(paste0(outdir,'/',prefix,'_reactome_dot.png',sep=''),width = 1080, height = 580)
    print(dotplot(ereactome,showCategory=20))
    dev.off()
}

#Do enrichment
do_enrich <- function(eg,db,outdir,prefix) {
    library(DOSE)
    library(UpSetR)
    library(validate)
    genelist <- eg$ENTREZID
    print(length(genelist))
    DO <- enrichDO(genelist, ont="DO", pvalueCutoff=1,qvalueCutoff = 1,pAdjustMethod="BH" ,minGSSize=3, readable=FALSE)
    DO <- setReadable(DO, OrgDb = db, keyType='ENTREZID')
    res_table <- as_tibble(DO) %>% mutate(Links=str_c('https://disease-ontology.org/?id=',ID))
    write.table(res_table,file=paste(outdir,'/',prefix,'_DOenrich.xls',sep=''),sep='\t',quote=F,row.names=F)

    pdf(paste0(outdir,'/',prefix,'_DO_cnetplot.pdf',sep=''))
    print(cnetplot(DO, categorySize="pvalue",colorEdge=TRUE))
    dev.off()
    pdf(paste0(outdir,'/',prefix,"_DO_bar.pdf",sep=''))
    print(barplot(DO, showCategory=10))
    dev.off()

    emap <- pairwise_termsim(DO, method = "JC", showCategory = 30)
    pdf(paste0(outdir,'/',prefix,"_emapplot.pdf",sep=''))
    print(emapplot(emap, showCategory = 10, color = "p.adjust"))
    dev.off()

    pdf(paste0(outdir,'/',prefix,"_upsetplot.pdf",sep=''))
    print(upsetplot(DO))
    dev.off()
}

if(By == "group"){
    files <- list.files(paste0(outdir,"/output/"),recursive=T,pattern="_significant_diff.xls")
    for (f in files){
      clu <- strsplit(strsplit(f,'\\.vs\\.')[[1]][1],'/')[[1]][1]
      vs <- paste0(strsplit(strsplit(f,'\\.vs\\.')[[1]][1],'/')[[1]][3],'.vs.',gsub('_significant_diff.xls','',strsplit(f,'\\.vs\\.')[[1]][2]))
      vs1 <- strsplit(vs,'\\.vs\\.')[[1]][1]
      vs2 <- strsplit(vs,'\\.vs\\.')[[1]][2]
      print(clu)
      print(vs)
      print(f)
      prefix.all <- paste0(clu,'_',vs,'_','ALL')
      prefix.up <- paste0(clu,'_',vs,'_','UP')
      prefix.down <- paste0(clu,'_',vs,'_','DOWN')
      f <- paste0(outdir,"/output/",f)
      clus_1<-read.table(f,header=T,sep='\t')
      clus_1.up <- filter(clus_1,cluster == vs1)
      clus_1.down <- filter(clus_1,cluster == vs2)
      clus <- clus_1$gene
      clus.up <- clus_1.up$gene
      clus.down <- clus_1.down$gene
      if (length(clus) > 9 ){
        skip <- FALSE
        eg <- bitr(clus, fromType="SYMBOL", toType=c("ENSEMBL","ENTREZID"), OrgDb=db)
        print(head(eg))
        if (plottype=='GO'){
          dir.create(paste0(outdir,"/output/",clu,"/clusterProfiler/GO"),recursive = TRUE)
          outdir1 <- paste0(outdir,"/output/",clu,"/clusterProfiler/GO")
          tryCatch({
                go_enrich(eg,db,outdir1,prefix.all)
          },error = function(e){
                print(paste0("Skip ",prefix.all," when analysis GO."))
                skip <- TRUE
          })
          if(skip){next}
        }else if(plottype=='KEGG'){
          dir.create(paste0(outdir,"/output/",clu,"/clusterProfiler/KEGG"),recursive = TRUE)
          outdir1 <- paste0(outdir,"/output/",clu,"/clusterProfiler/KEGG")
          tryCatch({
                kegg_enrich(eg,species,outdir1,prefix.all)
          },error = function(e){
                print(paste0("Skip ",prefix.all," when analysis KEGG."))
                skip <- TRUE
          })
          if(skip){next}
        }else if(plottype=='DO'){
          dir.create(paste0(outdir,"/output/",clu,"/clusterProfiler/DO"),recursive = TRUE)
          outdir1 <- paste0(outdir,"/output/",clu,"/clusterProfiler/DO")
          tryCatch({
                do_enrich(eg,db,outdir1,prefix)
          },error = function(e){
                print(paste0("Skip ",prefix.all," when analysis DO."))
                skip <- TRUE
          })
          if(skip){next}
        }else if(plottype=='reactome'){
          dir.create(paste0(outdir,"/output/",clu,"/clusterProfiler/reactome"),recursive = TRUE)
          outdir1 <- paste0(outdir,"/output/",clu,"/clusterProfiler/reactome")
          tryCatch({
                reactome_enrich(eg,spe,outdir1,prefix.all)
          },error = function(e){
                print(paste0("Skip ",prefix.all," when analysis reactome."))
                skip <- TRUE
          })
          if(skip){next}  
        }else{
          stop("the value of the 'plottype' parameter must be one of the GO,KEGG,reactome or DO.")
        }
      }
      if (length(clus.up) > 9 ){
        skip <- FALSE
        eg.up <- bitr(clus.up, fromType="SYMBOL", toType=c("ENSEMBL","ENTREZID"), OrgDb=db)
        print(head(eg.up))
        if (plottype=='GO'){
          tryCatch({
                go_enrich(eg.up,db,outdir1,prefix.up)
          },error = function(e){
                print(paste0("Skip ",prefix.up," when analysis GO."))
                skip <- TRUE
          })
          if(skip){next}
        }else if(plottype=='KEGG'){
          tryCatch({
                kegg_enrich(eg.up,species,outdir1,prefix.up)
          },error = function(e){
                print(paste0("Skip ",prefix.up," when analysis KEGG."))
                skip <- TRUE
          })
          if(skip){next}
        }else if(plottype=='DO'){
          tryCatch({
                do_enrich(eg.up,db,outdir1,prefix.up)
          },error = function(e){
                print(paste0("Skip ",prefix.up," when analysis DO."))
                skip <- TRUE
          })
          if(skip){next}
        }else if(plottype=='reactome'){
          tryCatch({
                reactome_enrich(eg.up,spe,outdir1,prefix.up)
          },error = function(e){
                print(paste0("Skip ",prefix.up," when analysis reactome."))
                skip <- TRUE
          })
          if(skip){next}  
        }else{
          stop("the value of the 'plottype' parameter must be one of the GO,KEGG,reactome or DO.")
        }
      }
      if (length(clus.down) > 9 ){
        skip <- FALSE
        eg.down <- bitr(clus.down, fromType="SYMBOL", toType=c("ENSEMBL","ENTREZID"), OrgDb=db)
        print(head(eg.down))
        if (plottype=='GO'){
          tryCatch({
                go_enrich(eg.down,db,outdir1,prefix.down)
          },error = function(e){
                print(paste0("Skip ",prefix.down," when analysis GO."))
                skip <- TRUE
          })
          if(skip){next}
        }else if(plottype=='KEGG'){
          tryCatch({
                kegg_enrich(eg.down,species,outdir1,prefix.down)
          },error = function(e){
                print(paste0("Skip ",prefix.down," when analysis KEGG."))
                skip <- TRUE
          })
          if(skip){next}
        }else if(plottype=='DO'){
          tryCatch({
                do_enrich(eg.down,db,outdir1,prefix.down)
          },error = function(e){
                print(paste0("Skip ",prefix.down," when analysis DO."))
                skip <- TRUE
          })
          if(skip){next}
        }else if(plottype=='reactome'){
          tryCatch({
                reactome_enrich(eg.down,spe,outdir1,prefix.down)
          },error = function(e){
                print(paste0("Skip ",prefix.down," when analysis reactome."))
                skip <- TRUE
          })
          if(skip){next}  
        }else{
          stop("the value of the 'plottype' parameter must be one of the GO,KEGG,reactome or DO.")
        }
      }
    }
}else if(By == "cluster"){
    files <- list.files(paste0(outdir,"/output/DIFF/DIFF/"),pattern="diff_significant.xls")
    for (f in files){
      prefix <- gsub('_diff_significant.xls','',f)
      f <- paste0(outdir,"/output/DIFF/DIFF/",f)
      print(f)
      print(prefix)
      clus_1<-read.table(f,header=T,sep='\t')
      clus<-clus_1$gene
      if (length(clus) > 9 ){ 
      eg <- bitr(clus, fromType="SYMBOL", toType=c("ENSEMBL","ENTREZID"), OrgDb=db)
      print(head(eg))
      if (plottype=='GO'){

      }else if(plottype=='KEGG'){

	    dir.create(paste0(outdir,"/output/clusterProfiler/reactome"),recursive = TRUE)

    }
}else{
     stop("the value of the 'By' parameter must be cluster or group.")
}


if (plottype=='GO'){
    setwd(paste0(outdir,"/output/clusterProfiler/GO"))
    xls_files <- list.files(pattern = "\\.xls$", full.names = TRUE)
    merged_data <- data.frame()
    for (file in xls_files) {
      df <- read.table(file,sep="\t",header=T)  # 读取Excel文件
      merged_data <- bind_rows(merged_data, df)  # 合并数据
    }
    write.table(merged_data, "all_GOenrich.xls", row.names = FALSE,sep="\t",quote=FALSE)
}else if(plottype=='KEGG'){

    merged_data <- data.frame()
    for (file in xls_files) {
      df <- read.table(file,sep="\t",header=T)  # 读取Excel文件
      merged_data <- bind_rows(merged_data, df)  # 合并数据
    }
    write.table(merged_data, "all_KEGGenrich.xls", row.names = FALSE,sep="\t",quote=FALSE)
}
```
